intent: bounded primary definition should use fast effort and stop early on strong evidence
technical identifier should preserve all materially supported variants
user language should discover organization-specific terminology from corpus intelligence
procedure fragments across documents should be joined without dropping conditions
enumeration should search document-diverse governing sections and avoid scenario-only completeness claims
recovery must preserve every original condition and cannot substitute a nearby procedure
each requested entity receives independent candidate and rerank coverage
both sides are retrieved independently before synthesis
scope, revision, authority and effective dates must remain attached to claims
synthesis joins only explicitly compatible evidence and cites each contributing source
research route uses coverage/section aggregation rather than fixed top-k alone
absence is not asserted from top-k retrieval
domain identifiers and exact phrases survive semantic retrieval
semantic lane recovers relevant evidence when exact words differ
previously supported evidence survives recovery and broadening
trace records exactly which evidence was sent to answer generation
